gap_topic: how long earned loyalty points stay valid

prd_facts.fact: A customer can ask for express delivery at checkout; it is off unless asked and costs a flat 25.00 for everybody, VIP or not.
Express delivery is never free, not even above the free-shipping amount; normal delivery keeps its current shipping rule.
Every order earns one loyalty point per full 10.00 of the amount after discounts, shipping not counted, rounded down; a VIP earns double.
The receipt carries the points as a whole number; the receipt text layout and as_dict do not change.
Applies to every order from now on, with no flag and no migration.
